clue.text: Put jacket on to follow pioneer

indicators.note: in an across clue 'put on' places the jacket after the first piece

parts.note: to trail someone is to follow them
a blazer is a kind of jacket

explanation.surface: Someone is told to put on a jacket before setting out after a pioneering leader.
explanation.definitionFit: A trailblazer is someone who breaks new ground, an innovator or forerunner.

clue.text: In fact, I bet Angus is a Highlander

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the phrase that follows, spanning the word breaks

explanation.surface: A remark that a man from Angus, a Scottish county, must be a Highlander.
explanation.walkthrough: Angus is a Scottish county, which steers you to Scottish Highlands, but the Highlander here lives in the Himalayas.
explanation.definitionFit: Tibet is a high plateau, so a native of it is a mountain dweller.

clue.text: A fight joined roughly

parts.note: a bout is a boxing fight

explanation.surface: Someone joined a scrap, more or less.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something is about ten means approximately ten.

clue.text: Clumsy felling trees

definitions.meaning: moving in a heavy, awkward way
cutting timber, as a lumberjack does

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both moving heavily and working at cutting timber.

clue.text: Enjoy being similar

definitions.meaning: resembling, as in 'two of a kind'

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb of fondness and a preposition or adjective of resemblance.

clue.text: When start is due, but nothing's on time

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece written on top of another comes first

parts.note: nothing is zero; the possessive adds no letters
an hour is a unit of time

explanation.surface: Something is supposed to begin, but nothing is running to schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names the moment a planned operation is set to begin.

clue.text: The police reflect on use of this gun

definitions.text: The police reflect on use of this gun

parts.words: The police reflect on use of this gun
parts.note: police speed guns work by bouncing signals off cars, and the word itself reads the same backwards, so it reflects

explanation.surface: Officers consider the use of a particular firearm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gun' suggests a weapon, but a traffic officer's speed gun is meant; the word is a palindrome, so it reflects too.
explanation.definitionFit: Speed-detection equipment used by traffic police relies on bounced radio waves.

clue.text: By which I mean might be replaced by the monarch?

definitions.text: By which I mean might be replaced by the monarch?

parts.words: By which I mean might be replaced by the monarch?
parts.note: a sovereign speaking formally refers to themself in the plural instead of saying I

explanation.surface: A speaker clarifies what they mean, wondering if a ruler would put it differently.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads 'by which I mean' as a phrase, but it is the pronoun 'I' that a king or queen replaces with the plural.
explanation.definitionFit: The plural pronoun used by a sovereign to mean themself is a royal convention.

clue.text: Con shore quizzically from ship

indicators.note: in a puzzled, odd fashion, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A trickster quizzes the shore from aboard a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A fore-and-aft rigged sailing vessel with two or more masts.

clue.text: Author, say, who attracts the punters

definitions.meaning: a writer makes books, read literally
a bookie takes bets from gamblers

explanation.definitionFit: Read literally the word is a maker of books; in betting it is a bookie.

clue.text: Richard 18 in poor condition

definitions.meaning: a familiar pet form of the name
unsound or shaky, as a weak heart is

explanation.definitionFit: It is a pet name for Richard and British slang for unreliable or unwell.

clue.text: Bird was first to be given a name

parts.note: the tit is a small songbird
someone who led was in front

explanation.surface: A bird was the first to receive a name.
explanation.definitionFit: Having been called by a particular name or heading, as a book is.

clue.text: Cleaner fuel, of a dark grey colour

definitions.meaning: a fuel burning cleaner than wood, used on barbecues
a shade named after burnt wood

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a carbon fuel from charred wood and a deep grey shade.

clue.text: No d-drink? Here's a little

parts.note: the stutter repeats the first letter of a drink, gin, as g-gin

explanation.surface: A stammering drinker turns down a drink, then accepts a small one.
explanation.walkthrough: The stammered 'd-drink' tells you to stutter the drink you choose too, giving G-GIN.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a small measure of spirits, a quarter of a pint.

clue.text: Large woman: it's Agnes in disguise

indicators.note: the letters are dressed up as something else, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A big woman is revealed to be Agnes wearing a disguise.
explanation.definitionFit: A female giant is a woman of huge size.

clue.text: Drunk, cause inn trouble

indicators.note: intoxicated, so the letters reel into a new order

explanation.surface: Drunkards cause trouble at a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Something annoying or bothersome is a pest or bother.

clue.text: Worker with horses is a steady chap

parts.note: stable means firm or steady
a man is a chap

explanation.surface: A groom is described as a reliable fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: A person employed to look after horses in a stable is a groom.

clue.text: Ignorant of poetry?

parts.note: the word means inexperienced, but split it reads as having no verse

explanation.surface: Someone who knows nothing about poems.
explanation.definitionFit: Inexperienced or unskilled in a subject, as if never schooled in it.

clue.text: Signalling one's getting tired?

explanation.definitionFit: It means both waving flags as signals and growing weary.

clue.text: Particular skill of university department?

definitions.meaning: a division of a university, such as the arts

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an aptitude and a group of academic departments.

clue.text: A sign twins are due next month

definitions.text: A sign twins are due next month

parts.words: A sign twins are due next month
parts.note: the zodiac sign just before Gemini, the twins, which follows it on the calendar

explanation.surface: An expectant mother learns her twins arrive next month.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Twins are due' suggests pregnancy, but the twins are Gemini, the star sign after this one.
explanation.definitionFit: The zodiac sign of the bull runs from late April to late May, just before Gemini.

clue.text: Excess of waves-tie up

parts.note: surf is breaking waves

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is written bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Too many waves have tied something up.
explanation.definitionFit: An overabundance or overindulgence of something.

clue.text: Get actor to represent rural worker

indicators.note: the letters are made to stand for something new, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Cast an actor to portray a farm labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who lives in a cottage, traditionally a farm labourer.

clue.text: Fall sick touring Puerto Rico for a month

indicators.note: going round something, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: to ail is to be unwell

explanation.surface: A traveller gets ill while touring Puerto Rico for a month.
explanation.definitionFit: The fourth month of the year.

clue.text: River rose, for example

definitions.meaning: a rose is one kind of bloom

explanation.definitionFit: A river is something that flows; a rose is a bloom.

clue.text: Your answer to this clue won't be right

definitions.text: Your answer to this clue won't be right

parts.words: Your answer to this clue won't be right
parts.note: the solver's entry is the word meaning incorrect, so it is correct

explanation.surface: A warning that the solver will get this one incorrect.
explanation.definitionFit: Incorrect or mistaken is the opposite of right.

clue.text: Manage company on exercise

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercise

explanation.surface: A firm runs a fitness programme and gets by.
explanation.definitionFit: To get by or deal with a difficulty is to handle it.

clue.text: Failure is nearer losing head

parts.note: closer means nearer

explanation.surface: Someone close to it loses their nerve and fails.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who fails or is beaten.

clue.text: Violent argument about one that flies in a gale

parts.note: a storm is an angry outburst or row
c, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: A fierce row breaks out about something flying in high winds.
explanation.walkthrough: C (circa, about) and ONE make CONE.
explanation.definitionFit: A cone-shaped signal hoisted at coastal stations to warn of high winds.

clue.text: Delights in a dance to which partners are specially invited

definitions.text: to which partners are specially invited

indicators.note: the letters dance about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone delights in a dance where partners get a special invitation.
explanation.definitionFit: An evening when women, often partners of members, are invited to a club event.
